name: KOSPI vs NASDAQ Dot-Com: Which Rally Was Steeper?
description: Compares the 1990s KOSPI bull run (proxied by KF — Korea Fund, trough ~Aug 1992 to peak ~Nov 1994) against the NASDAQ dot-com run-up (proxied by NQ — NASDAQ-100 E-Mini Futures, trough ~Oct 1998 to peak ~Mar 2000) on a normalized basis. Both series are rebased to 100 at their respective cycle trough and aligned on a common 'bars elapsed since trough' X axis to directly compare steepness. Includes overlaid line chart, scatter with OLS trend lines, and summary statistics table.
source:
# ============================================================
# KOSPI (KF) vs NASDAQ Dot-Com (NQ): Normalized Rally Comparison
# ============================================================
# KF trough ~Aug 1992, peak ~Nov 1994 (KOSPI bull run)
# NQ trough ~Oct 1998, peak ~Mar 2000 (dot-com run-up)
# Both normalized to 100 at trough, aligned by bars-since-trough.

# --- Trough / Peak Timestamps ---
kf_trough_start = Timestamp(value="1992-08-01")
kf_peak_end = Timestamp(value="1994-11-30")
nq_trough_start = Timestamp(value="1998-10-01")
nq_peak_end = Timestamp(value="2000-03-31")

# --- Data ---
kf_raw = reference_stocks(ticker="KF")()
nq_raw = reference_futures(ticker="NQ")()
nq_cont = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardRatio)(nq_raw.o, nq_raw.h, nq_raw.l, nq_raw.c, nq_raw.v, nq_raw.oi, nq_raw.s)

ts = index().value

# --- KF: Filter to rally window ---
kf_in_window = ts >= kf_trough_start and ts <= kf_peak_end
kf_close_window = where(kf_in_window, kf_raw.c)

# KF trough value = first close in window (expanding First)
kf_trough_val = agg(kf_close_window, AggregationType.First)

# KF normalized to 100 at trough
kf_norm = where(kf_in_window, (kf_raw.c / kf_trough_val) * 100.0)

# KF bars since trough: cumulative count of valid bars in window
kf_bar_flag = 1.0 if kf_in_window else 0.0
kf_bars_cum = cumulative(where(kf_in_window, kf_bar_flag))
kf_bars_elapsed = where(kf_in_window, kf_bars_cum - 1.0)

# KF daily return within window
kf_prev = kf_raw.c >> 1
kf_daily_ret = where(kf_in_window and is_valid(kf_prev), (kf_raw.c - kf_prev) / kf_prev)

# KF peak normalized value
kf_peak_norm = agg(kf_norm, AggregationType.Max)
# KF total % gain
kf_total_gain = kf_peak_norm - 100.0
# KF bars to peak
kf_peak_bar = agg(kf_bars_elapsed, AggregationType.Max)
# KF avg daily % gain (total gain / bars to peak)
kf_avg_daily = kf_total_gain / kf_peak_bar
# KF max single-bar % gain
kf_max_daily = agg(kf_daily_ret, AggregationType.Max)

# --- NQ: Filter to rally window ---
nq_in_window = ts >= nq_trough_start and ts <= nq_peak_end
nq_close_window = where(nq_in_window, nq_cont.c)

# NQ trough value = first close in window
nq_trough_val = agg(nq_close_window, AggregationType.First)

# NQ normalized to 100 at trough
nq_norm = where(nq_in_window, (nq_cont.c / nq_trough_val) * 100.0)

# NQ bars since trough
nq_bar_flag = 1.0 if nq_in_window else 0.0
nq_bars_cum = cumulative(where(nq_in_window, nq_bar_flag))
nq_bars_elapsed = where(nq_in_window, nq_bars_cum - 1.0)

# NQ daily return within window
nq_prev = nq_cont.c >> 1
nq_daily_ret = where(nq_in_window and is_valid(nq_prev), (nq_cont.c - nq_prev) / nq_prev)

# NQ peak normalized value
nq_peak_norm = agg(nq_norm, AggregationType.Max)
# NQ total % gain
nq_total_gain = nq_peak_norm - 100.0
# NQ bars to peak
nq_peak_bar = agg(nq_bars_elapsed, AggregationType.Max)
# NQ avg daily % gain
nq_avg_daily = nq_total_gain / nq_peak_bar
# NQ max single-bar % gain
nq_max_daily = agg(nq_daily_ret, AggregationType.Max)

# --- CHART 1: Overlaid Normalized Rally Lines ---
xy_lines(
    title="Which Rally Was Steeper? KOSPI vs NASDAQ Dot-Com",
    x_axis_label="Bars Elapsed Since Trough",
    y_axis_label="Normalized Index (100 = Trough)",
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=0,
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat,
    category="Rally Comparison",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="KF (KOSPI 1992-94)", color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="NQ (NASDAQ 1998-00)", color=Color.Orange)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=100.0, title="Trough (100)", color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=kf_bars_elapsed, y_values=(kf_norm, nq_norm))

# --- CHART 2: Scatter with OLS Trend Lines ---
xy_scatter(
    title="Rate of Ascent: OLS Slope Comparison",
    x_axis_label="Bars Elapsed Since Trough",
    y_axis_label="Normalized Index (100 = Trough)",
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=0,
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat,
    category="Rally Comparison",
    series=ScatterSeriesSchema(series=[
        ScatterSeriesSpec(name="KF (KOSPI 1992-94)", color=Color.Blue, marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker),
        ScatterSeriesSpec(name="NQ (NASDAQ 1998-00)", color=Color.Orange, marker=MarkerSymbol.DiamondMarker)
    ]),
    show_trend_line=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=100.0, title="Trough (100)", color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=2
)(x=kf_bars_elapsed, y_values=(kf_norm, nq_norm))

# --- TABLE: Summary Comparison ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category="Rally Comparison",
    order=3,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title="Rally Steepness: KOSPI vs NASDAQ Dot-Com",
        row_size=2, col_size=5,
        row_headers=["KF (KOSPI 1992-94)", "NQ (NASDAQ 1998-00)"],
        col_headers=["Peak Index Value", "Total % Gain", "Bars to Peak", "Avg Daily % Gain", "Max Daily % Gain"],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=0, info="Peak normalized value (100 = trough)"),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, info="Total % gain from trough to peak"),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, info="Trading days from trough to peak"),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3, info="Total gain / bars to peak"),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, info="Largest single-day return during rally"),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=0, info="Peak normalized value (100 = trough)"),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, info="Total % gain from trough to peak"),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, info="Trading days from trough to peak"),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3, info="Total gain / bars to peak"),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, info="Largest single-day return during rally")
        ]
    )
)(kf_peak_norm, kf_total_gain / 100.0, kf_peak_bar, kf_avg_daily / 100.0, kf_max_daily, nq_peak_norm, nq_total_gain / 100.0, nq_peak_bar, nq_avg_daily / 100.0, nq_max_daily)
